zones.text:
Generative AI Development Services
Production-ready generative AI delivery covering GenAI integration, multi-agent orchestration, optimization and evaluation, and ongoing support and governance. GoGloby's Applied AI Software Engineers build copilots, AI agents, RAG applications, and agentic workflows using LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, and AutoGen. Forward-deployed into your team in under 4 weeks. Zero IP exposure. $3M combined liability (cyber, data and professional) from day one.
What Types of Generative AI Solutions Can GoGloby Build for Enterprise Teams?
GoGloby builds copilots, RAG applications, AI agents, agentic workflows, document intelligence systems, and customer-facing AI products. Every build runs on Agentic SDLC mastery inside your own perimeter — production-ready, governed, and integrated into your existing stack.
How Long Does It Take to Launch a Production-Ready Generative AI Project?
First Applied AI Software Engineer is embedded in under 4 weeks. Measurable velocity improvement — 35–45% agentic commit rate — is typically reached by month 2. Full benchmark of 60–70% agentic commit rate is reached by month 6.
How Does GoGloby Handle Security, Compliance, and IP Protection?
Your environment, your code, your data. Engineers operate inside your own perimeter under zero-trust access controls, audit logging, and model routing policy. Zero IP exposure to GoGloby systems. $3M combined liability (cyber, data and professional), included from day one.
What Makes GoGloby Different From a Generic AI Vendor or Staffing Agency?
GoGloby delivers all four layers as one integrated Applied AI Engineering Pod — vetted talent, Agentic Workflow, the Layer telemetry, and work that stays inside your own perimeter. Generic vendors give you one piece. GoGloby delivers the complete operating model with measurable velocity benchmarks, not just engineers.
Can GoGloby Work With Our Existing Models, Data Stack, and Engineering Team?
Yes. GoGloby's Applied AI Software Engineers embed directly into your existing team, integrate with your current data stack, and work with your chosen models. No rip-and-replace. Agentic Workflow is deployed on top of your existing CI/CD pipeline.
How Do You Measure Whether Generative AI Delivery Is Actually Improving Performance?
The Layer tracks AI Contribution Ratio, agentic commit rate, PR turnaround, build stability, and bug density directly from CI/CD metadata — sprint by sprint. Every sprint produces a board-ready report. No black box, no end-of-project summaries.

Why GoGloby is Different
Applied AI Engineering: One System, Not Four Vendors
GoGloby’s Applied AI Engineering solves all 4 problems every tech leader faces in the agentic AI era, talent, workflow, performance, and security, delivered as one integrated Applied AI Engineering Pod. Generic vendors give you one piece: a developer, a tool, or a consultant.
1. TALENT
AI Solutions Architect
The AI Solutions Architect is the vetted talent layer inside GoGloby’s generative AI development services: a senior engineer who has passed a 4-stage technical evaluation covering spec execution, context engineering, system architecture, and AI governance. Only the top 4% of our curated pipeline qualify.
Outcomes
Arrives with proven Agentic SDLC mastery, ready to ship production-grade generative AI from sprint one, not after months of onboarding.
Prevents
ChatGPT hobbyists and vibe coders never reach your team. Each candidate is eliminated through 4 progressive stages before you see a single profile.
Guarantees

2. PERFORMANCE
The Layer
The Layer is the telemetry layer that makes generative AI development services measurable, tracking AI Contribution Ratio, agentic commit rate, and velocity acceleration from CI/CD metadata, sprint by sprint.
Outcomes
Teams reach 35 to 45% agentic commit rate by month 2 and 60 to 70% by month 6, tracked automatically, not estimated.
Prevents
Silent drift, invisible plateaus, and vanity metrics. Every sprint produces a board-ready performance report with hard data.
Guarantees
Delivery velocity tracked against your own baseline from day one. Not a benchmark, your number.
3. SECURITY
Everything Runs Inside Your Perimeter
The AI Intelligence Layer deploys in your VPC, so your code, your data and your metrics stay in your environment. Our engineers work through your pipeline with the access you grant, logged like any employee and revocable any day. Your access rules, not ours.
Outcomes
Zero IP exposure from day one. Your environment, your code, your data. Your embedded architect operates inside it, never around it.
Prevents
Public AI tool usage, prompt leakage, and compliance violations. Every action runs under access controls, audit logging, and model routing policy.
Guarantees
$3M combined liability (cyber, data and professional) included. Governance gates active from sprint one. Compliant with your data residency requirements.

zones.label: Accordion 2: AI Governance Framework
zones.text:
AI Governance Framework
Every engagement ships with defined delegation boundaries, prompt conventions, and review criteria before a single line of code is written. Governance is not a retrospective audit. It is the operating layer your team runs on from day one.
Access Control Matrix
Every engineer operates under role-based access controls tied to your environment. No engineer accesses data, models, or pipelines outside their defined scope. Full audit trail maintained from day one.
Virtual Environments
Each engagement runs inside an isolated virtual environment. Your codebase, data, and models never share infrastructure with other clients or public AI tools.
Zero-Trust Network
No implicit trust at any layer. Every request is authenticated, every connection is encrypted, every action is logged. Engineers operate inside the perimeter, never around it.
Compliance and Attestations
Working inside your own perimeter supports your compliance requirements, including data residency, access governance, and audit readiness. Documentation available on request.
Privacy and PII Handling
PII is masked or tokenized before it reaches any model layer. Vector database design and retrieval pipelines are scoped to prevent exposure at the architecture level, not patched after deployment.
Model and Prompt Safety
Model routing policy and cost guardrails are active from sprint one. Prompt injection mitigations and circuit breakers are implemented and tested before any model goes to production.
Observability and Audit
Every AI action is logged: commits, prompt calls, model outputs, and access events. Sprint-by-sprint audit trail delivered through the Layer.
Legal and IP Protection
Your environment, your code, your data. GoGloby engineers operate inside your infrastructure. Zero IP exposure to GoGloby systems. $3M combined liability (cyber, data and professional), included from day one.
Incident Response and Resilience
Defined escalation paths, incident playbooks, and rollback procedures are established before go-live. No reactive firefighting. Every engagement ships with a documented response plan.
What does the Benchmark include?
Every engagement starts with the Benchmark: a fixed fee for one month, with the AI Intelligence Layer deployed inside your VPC and your baseline delivered at the end of it. The fee is credited in full toward your first month of delivery. If you stop there, you keep the baseline.
